Attributes:

The name and the look are fixed. The joke ending is one of the jewelry suffixes. That ending is what sets the primaries.

The rest of the stats roll and do not show up in the name.

  • Resists: a random pair or triple from divine, fire, ice, poison, and shadow.
  • Speed: movement speed and/or attack or cast speed. Random.
  • Stun: enemy stun chance, stun resistance, or both. Random.
  • Speed: movement speed, melee attack speed, or both. Random.
  • Speed: movement speed, casting speed, or both. Random.
  • Speed: movement speed, ranged attack speed, or both. Random.

It is unknown how many different varieties exist. The same ending can still drop with different rolls underneath.

It is unknown how many different varieties of this particular mythic item exist. Some of the Mythic items in this series may have the same name but different attributes.
